meta.purpose: Ergonomics tracker for motorized sit/stand desk — detects sitting/standing via VL53L1X ToF laser sensor, tracks sessions, nudges user to take breaks
meta.target-user: Single user (zentala) at a motorized sit/stand desk

hardware.sensor: Grove VL53L1X v2 — mounted under desk, pointing down to floor

feature.name: desk-state-detection
feature.description: Detects SITTING / STANDING / WALKING / AWAY based on sensor distance + keyboard/mouse activity
feature.debounce: 5 stable readings required before state change

feature.name: session-tracking
feature.description: Tracks sitting session duration, enforces 40-min default limit, break credit rules

feature.name: points-system
feature.description: +1/min standing, +5/lap bonus, -0.5/min sitting; daily_score in tooltip + floating window

feature.name: standing-progress-bar
feature.description: Gold overlay bar fills 0-to-standing_target_mins, lap flash at 100%

feature.name: ui
feature.component: Height tooltip, colored dot icon (green/yellow/red/gold), context menu
Widget-based: OneBar, TimelineZen, or Placeholder via registry
4px top-of-screen WinAPI bar, green-to-red (sitting) or gold (standing)
WinAPI popup at session limit, progressive escalation with snooze
First-launch onboarding, Tauri WebviewWindow, dismiss persisted

feature.name: widget-system
feature.description: WidgetProps interface + registry; active_widget in AppConfig; widgets are FC components

feature.name: persistence
feature.description: SQLite stores session history, today summaries

feature.name: settings
feature.description: Sit/stand limits, calibration, notification prefs, widget picker — tauri-plugin-store

feature.name: auto-connect
feature.description: Auto-detects zntl-desk-sensor v1 on serial ports via PING/PONG handshake

feature.name: notifications
feature.description: Native desktop notifications with trigger_test_notification command, configurable backend

layer.name: firmware
layer.file: Arduino sketch — reads VL53L1X, PING/PONG handshake, emits distance at 115200 baud

layer.name: rust-backend
layer.file: App entry — plugins, AppState, setup hook (tray, blur, serial, welcome)
IPC commands: list_ports, start_auto_connect, stop_reading, get_session_state, get_today_summary, inject_reading, trigger_test_notification, dismiss_welcome, show_welcome
Config IPC: set_session_limit, set_stand_limit, calibrate, get_settings, save_settings, get_overlay_state
Structs: SessionState, SessionStateDto, DeskState, StateChangedPayload, AppConfig fields
SessionManager impl: on_reading, state transitions, score accumulation
Reading processing logic split from session_manager
Background serial reader — auto-detect, parse, emit events
System tray — icon, tooltip, context menu, left-click toggle
Wires desk events to tray + overlay + alerts
Generates RGBA tray icons by state + progress (white base + colored dot)
Standing bar render logic (gold bar + lap indicators)

layer.name: react-frontend
layer.file: Root — widget system, settings panel, state management
Shared types: DeskState, SessionStateDto, TodaySummaryDto, WidgetProps

dir.name: widgets/
dir.file: Widget map + resolver (active_widget string to component)
Horizontal progress bar, temperature escalation, coach sentence
Minimalist, big timeline, zero text, ultra compact
Hook: resolves active widget from config
Hook: computes derived WidgetProps from useDesk + useTimer
Type definitions for desk hook data

dir.name: components/
dir.file: Settings UI — limits, calibration, notifications, widget picker
Today totals: sitting, standing, changes, score

dir.name: hooks/
dir.file: Main data hook — desk:* events, IPC state

layer.name: ipc-commands
layer.command: Mark welcome popup as dismissed in config

layer.name: unit-rust
layer.files: session_tests.rs, session_tests_alerts.rs, session_tests_daily.rs, session_tests_props.rs, session_tests_floating.rs, session_tests_score.rs, overlay_tests.rs, overlay_variant_tests.rs, overlay_standing_tests.rs, alert_manager_tests.rs, alert_snooze_tests.rs, config_tests.rs, db_tests.rs, tray_controller_tests.rs

layer.name: integration
layer.note: App must be running: pnpm tauri:dev

config-files.file: Window config, bundle, CSP, welcome window
Rust deps: tauri2, rusqlite, serialport, chrono, tokio, window-vibrancy, windows
Vite + Vitest, 80% coverage gate, welcome entry
